## About

This live demo showcases brand.yml, a Posit project that simplifies theming across R data science outputs. Starting from a set of brand guidelines, we translate colors, typography, and logos into a `_brand.yml` file and use it to style a Shiny app, a Quarto report, and a presentation—all from a single source of truth.

The demo uses a fictional company, Pulse Mobile, to walk through how brand.yml can be applied to create consistent, professional-looking outputs across different formats.
